_doc: Descriptions VISUELLES (en anglais, pour le générateur d'images). Dans les lignes '@' des histoires, {nom} est remplacé par la description ; pour un héros, {nom} ajoute le costume de l'univers et {nom-} donne le héros sans costume. Pas de prénom dans les descriptions : le modèle l'écrirait dans l'image.

heros.filou: the only fox in the picture, a small red fox cub with bright orange fur, a white belly, a white tail tip and a little green scarf
heros.nestor: the only bear in the picture, a big round brown bear cub with a cream muzzle, a tiny round tail and a little blue scarf
heros.rosie: a small pure white rabbit with long upright ears, pink inside, and a little red scarf
heros.plume: the only owl in the picture, a small round pale beige owl with big round dark eyes, a cream face and a little yellow scarf

costumes.pirates: wearing a striped sailor shirt and a red pirate bandana
costumes.chevaliers: wearing a plain yellow medieval tunic
costumes.espace: wearing a white astronaut suit and a clear round glass bubble helmet
costumes.ocean: with the whole head inside a clear round glass bubble diving helmet
costumes.noel: wearing a red woolly hat with a white pompom
costumes.ski: wearing a beige woolly hat with a pompom and a warm winter jacket

decors.pirates: a small wooden pirate ship with cream sails on a calm blue sea near a little island with a palm tree
decors.dino: a sunny prehistoric valley with giant ferns, a river and a distant volcano
decors.chevaliers: a cheerful medieval castle with towers and colourful flags on a green hill
decors.espace: outer space with colourful planets, stars, a moon and a small red and white rocket
decors.foret: a sunny forest clearing with four big oak trees, soft grass and flowers
decors.ocean: a colourful coral reef deep under the sea with striped fish and bubbles
decors.noel: a snowy forest village at night with glowing lanterns, a decorated Christmas tree and falling snow
decors.halloween: a forest village on Halloween night with glowing carved pumpkins, a big moon and autumn leaves
decors.ski: a snowy mountain ski resort with fir trees, a wooden chalet and a chairlift under a blue sky
decors.mer: a sunny beach with dunes, a striped parasol, sandcastles and gentle waves

seconds.mirabelle: one old dark brown otter with a cream muzzle and long white whiskers, wearing a big plain blue captain hat
seconds.sardine: one tiny light grey mouse with big round pink ears, much smaller than the others, in a blue and white striped shirt
seconds.griffard: one scruffy dark grey cat with a black pirate eye patch covering one eye only, the other eye yellow and visible, and a red bandana on the head
seconds.coquille: a small round wooden pirate ship with cream sails
seconds.dipla: one very old gentle light green diplodocus on four thick legs, with one very long neck, a small head and tiny round gold spectacles
seconds.tric: one small chubby orange baby triceratops dinosaur walking on four legs, with a big round bony frill behind the head, one small horn on the nose and two horns above the eyes
seconds.grondar: one huge dark green tyrannosaurus standing on two big legs, with tiny arms, a big square head, a pale belly and a smooth back
seconds.gontran: one tall blue peacock with a small blue crest, a shiny silver breastplate and a big green and blue fan tail
seconds.braise: one small chubby baby dragon with plain lilac purple skin, a cream belly, two tiny horns and tiny wings
seconds.balthazar: one old plump black raven bird with black feathers and a grey beak, wearing a tall pointed dark blue hat with yellow stars
seconds.hermine: one small elegant white cat with a small golden crown and a red cape
seconds.pepin: one tiny round brown hedgehog with dark spines on the back and a cream face, small enough to sit in a paw
seconds.bip: one small white robot shaped like a smooth ball, no ears, no fur, no scarf, with one single big round blue eye in the middle, one thin antenna on top and two short metal arms
seconds.gloup: one small fluffy lilac purple round ball monster, a cyclops with exactly one big eye in the centre of the face, a wide smiling mouth and two tiny feet
seconds.zig: one small green jelly blob alien shaped like a water drop, floating, no arms, no legs, no feet, with three eyes on three thin stalks on top
seconds.fusee: a small red and white retro rocket with one round window and no face
seconds.margot: one magpie bird with a black head, black wings, a white belly and a long black tail
seconds.loupiot: one small thin light grey wolf cub with a white chest, pointed ears and big paws
seconds.noisette: one small red squirrel with reddish-brown fur, a cream belly, tufted ears and a big curled bushy tail
seconds.pompon: one tiny baby white rabbit with very short round ears and a round fluffy tail, half the size of the other rabbit, wearing a light blue bib
seconds.mathurine: one old green tortoise on four legs with a wrinkled green head and a domed mossy shell
seconds.octave: one bright orange octopus with a big round head and eight long curly tentacles instead of legs, wearing small round black glasses
seconds.perle: one tiny pale pink seahorse with a curled tail and a small crest, small enough to sit in a paw
seconds.ondine: one huge adult blue whale with a long body, a pale grooved belly and a small kind eye
seconds.perenoel: one big old white polar bear animal with round ears and a black nose, not a human, wearing a red coat and a red hat with white fur trim
seconds.gustave: one old brown reindeer with large antlers, a grey muzzle and a red scarf
seconds.grognard: one old stocky badger animal with grey fur, a black and white striped badger face, small round glasses and a grey cardigan
seconds.vesper: one tiny cute brown bat with big round ears and thin wings, no bigger than an apple
seconds.cabri: one old brown mountain goat with two short curved horns and a small white beard, wearing a red ski jacket and a silver whistle
seconds.roupille: one plump brown marmot with small round ears
seconds.otto: one friendly plump grey seal with white whiskers, wearing a plain red swimming cap and a whistle
seconds.lila: one small brown otter child with a cream belly and a pink shell necklace
seconds.mamanlapin: one tall adult white mother rabbit with long upright ears, twice the size of the little rabbit, wearing a pale yellow apron
seconds.morse: one big fat brown walrus with two long white tusks and a grey moustache, wearing a blue and white striped swimsuit
seconds.crabe: one small round red crab with two little claws and two black eyes on short stalks
seconds.goeland: one young fluffy light grey seagull chick with a white belly, a short orange beak and orange feet
seconds.mamanchouette: one mother owl twice as tall as the little owl, with soft beige feathers, big round dark eyes and a pale blue knitted shawl

style: Children's picture book illustration, flat 2D vector art, clean thin dark outlines, flat soft pastel colours, simple rounded shapes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no humans.
fin: Cute gentle animal characters, each one drawn only once.
